label: FAKE: hand-written demo data, not real model output
purpose: Demo test cases, one per criterion.

test_cases.title: Budget code required
steps: Fill in the request without a budget code
test_cases.expected_result: The request is not submitted and the budget code field is marked as missing.

test_cases.title: Quote required
steps: Fill in the request without attaching a quote
test_cases.expected_result: The request is not submitted and the user is asked to attach at least one quote.

test_cases.title: Complete request is saved
test_cases.expected_result: The request is saved and a reference number is shown.

test_cases.title: Under 5,000 EUR: department head only
test_cases.expected_result: Only the department head is asked to approve.

test_cases.title: 5,000 to 50,000 EUR: head and finance
test_cases.expected_result: The department head and finance are asked to approve.

test_cases.title: Over 50,000 EUR: managing director too
test_cases.expected_result: The department head, finance and the managing director are asked to approve.

test_cases.title: Requester sees status
test_cases.expected_result: The current status and the awaited approver are shown.

test_cases.title: Reminder after the waiting period
preconditions: A request is waiting for an approver
steps: Let the reminder period pass without action

test_cases.title: Rejection needs a reason
preconditions: Approver has a request to approve

test_cases.title: Requester gets the rejection reason
preconditions: Approver has a request to approve
test_cases.expected_result: The requester is notified with the reason.

test_cases.title: Approval is recorded
preconditions: A request is waiting for approval
test_cases.expected_result: User, action, date and time are recorded, and the entry cannot be changed.

test_cases.title: Approved request reaches the ERP
steps: Search for the request in the ERP system
test_cases.expected_result: The request appears in the ERP system.

test_cases.title: Urgent request handling
test_cases.expected_result: The request is approved as appropriate.
